title: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

sense.text:
“Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil”: the Most High pronounces destruction on them that turn things upside down, “that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter.”

That is exactly what is being done today with the chariots of God. The leaders of this nation, the vice president on a podcast, congresswomen on the news, are calling what the world names aliens, UFOs and UAPs demons and fallen angels. They are calling good evil. Those are the chariots of God, and the angels in them are black. The Bible shows the chariots of God are the angels.

This is popular persuasion: Esau is laying the road map to persuade the minds of the people that the coming invasion is demonic, so that when the heavenly armies come, the people, especially our brothers and sisters in the military, will be deceived into fighting Christ. The devil’s great trick, they say, is convincing people he does not exist. The devil is them. Keep the topic in mind: fighting against heaven, defending earth.

“Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air.” He is called the prince of the power of the air because he controls the airwaves: the media, the communication, broadcasting. That is why the book of Revelation speaks of the mouth of the dragon and the mouth of the beast, his communication through his media.

This man controls the media not only in America but globally. Everything we do as a people is shaped by public opinion, shaped by the persuasion of Esau, the so-called white man, because he controls social media and the news, and his thoughts become our thoughts. That is why it is called networking and broadcasting: broadcasting his opinions. And his opinions, which are lies, now say the chariots are evil and demonic, to persuade the minds of the people to fight against Christ.

“And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people”: the he is Christ. The covering is cast over all people, not just people in America but globally. That is why in whatever church, continent, country or island you sit, they all think the white man is God and that Christ is white. Soon they will all utter the same sentiment, that the UFOs are demonic fallen angels.

How is he going to destroy it? He is using us to do it: to cast down the lies, to take the lies Esau has told our people and turn them right side up into truth.

“And the vail that is spread over all nations.” How did he spread this vail over all nations? Through his media, his network, his communication, because he is the prince of the power of the air. He controls the airwaves. And this mountain is not Mount Ararat or Kilimanjaro; it is America, Babylon the great.

precepts.why:
“The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see”: Babylon the great. “Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”: that high mountain is America. God says to lift up a banner there, and the banner is the Bible.

“Exalt the voice unto them”: that is what we do every day, every time we go to camp and every time we do these classes to cast down lies. “Shake the hand”: rebuke them.

So the high mountain of Isaiah 13 shows what the mountain of Isaiah 25:7 is: Babylon the great, America. In this mountain Christ will destroy the covering cast over all people.

“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”: Babylon is America, and Jeremiah is speaking prophetically of America. The great voice is the communication, his airwaves. This was brought out by the Bishop in the podcast he sat for recently.

“When her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered.” The waves roar like great waters because the waves of evil communication, the lies and rhetoric he spews, have gone out into all nations. That is how he caused all nations to fornicate, and that is the vail spread over all nations that Christ will destroy.

sense.text:
Satan’s first weapon was persuasion. Eve was not subdued physically by the devil; she was subdued with words.

“Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field”: the serpent is a beast, and in the scriptures the Most High likens men to beasts, so this serpent is a representation of men. More subtil means more crafty, better with his lies, better with his persuasion.

“Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?” Notice what he comes with: doubt and fear. He did not come to her physically or yoke her up; he came with persuasion.

The woman answered rightly: “of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.” She was correct; the Most High had told them not to eat of that tree.

“Ye shall not surely die”: doubt. “Ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.” Eve was already a goddess at that time, supposed to be eternal and live forever. But he threw doubt in there to persuade her to eat of the fruit.

“She took of the fruit thereof, and did eat”, because she was persuaded by the serpent. The serpent went to the woman first. That is why God commands the woman, if she will learn anything, to learn of her husband at home, and why it is not permitted for the woman to speak in the church: she is prone to idolatry, to lies, to persuasion.

“And gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat”: she defiled Adam as well. The serpent did not use force; he used words to sway Eve’s perception of reality, and then she went into sin.

precepts.why:
“I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” In the scriptures the Most High compares men to beasts.

So when Genesis says the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field, the serpent is a representation of men: a man more crafty than the rest, better with his lies and his persuasion.

sense.text:
Christ was cutting the Pharisees: “Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.” “He was a murderer from the beginning”: that is talking about Cain. The serpent seed is Cain, and Cain came back as Esau, the so-called white man, the pureblooded Caucasian man.

“And abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him.” We see that today in all the lies he spews through his communication and media, as in the articles just read.

“When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own”: he makes up things that are not biblically backed. “For he is a liar, and the father of it”: he is the pioneer of lying. Even when he speaks the truth it is a lie. You have to take everything with a grain of salt when it comes to Esau.

“That this is a rebellious people, lying children”: our people are rebellious and do not want to follow the laws of the Lord. We are lying children; it seems we are in competition with Esau, the father of lies. Our people are subdued in lies and ignorance, and willfully. “Children that will not hear the law of the Lord”: we want lies.

“Which say to the seers, See not”: they say that to us every sabbath day. They do not want to hear the Bible, like the young lady on the podcast who says Deuteronomy 28 is not talking about us and never happened, while she wears the apparel of Esau, her hair down to her back, pants on, dressed like a man, spewing the rhetoric of the apologists.

“Prophesy not unto us right things”: don’t prophesy laws we have to keep, that Christ is black and is coming back only for the Israelites, that we have to repent and keep his commandments and the faith of him. “Speak unto us smooth things”: the laws are done away with, it doesn’t matter what color Christ or God is, we can all be saved by grace, nothing wrong with the chitlins, the pork, the shrimp, crab and lobster as long as you pray over it. That is Christianity, smooth lies. “Prophesy deceits.”
“Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us”: they want the Holy One of Israel out of the way.

“Because ye despise this word”: because you despise this Bible. “And trust in oppression and perverseness”: you trust in Esau, in the so-called white man’s doctrines and philosophies, everything that comes out of the mouth of the beast, that great voice that comes out of Babylon.
“Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall”: you are going to die in your sins. He will give you up to your own delusions, and the breaking comes “suddenly at an instant.”
“A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land.” In Jeremiah’s time he was speaking of the prophets of the land, our people.

“The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means.” Bring it to today prophetically: we have black pastors and priests prophesying lies to our people in their churches. But who did they learn from? Esau, the so-called white man, in his seminaries, where they learned their theology. So prophetically he is speaking of Babylon as well.

“And my people love to have it so.” That is what we saw in the young lady with the apologist talking points, and in the Christian black pastors now saying the chariots are demons and fallen angels. Whatever Esau utters, they repeat. They love the lies.

“And what will ye do in the end thereof?” Esau is not coming to save you. There is nothing you can do in the end but die a terrible death when you are cast into the lake of fire.

precepts.why:
“Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”: that is America, Babylon the great. “Because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: with her policies, and her policies are orchestrated through communication, that great voice, that vail covering the face of the whole earth.

“If any man worship the beast and his image”: the beast is this white man, and the image of the beast is Cesare, the white image of Jesus. “And receive his mark in his forehead”: it is in your mind; “or in his hand”: you support it, because your hands are what you work with to support. The mark is his policies, his sin.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation.” Without mixture: when men take a strong drink they dilute it with water or chase it with juice. The Most High says no; you will drink the dregs of this cup at 100 proof, bourbon whiskey shoved down your damn throat, all the wrath of God with nothing to chase it. “And he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: Christ will be right there with the angels watching you burn.

That is not only the nations; it includes two thirds of our people who continue in his mark, support this system and refuse to repent. That is what they will do in the end thereof: burn in the lake of fire.

sense.text:
“And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs”: unclean means defiled, lies. The three unclean spirits are politics, religion, and wealth or finance.

“Out of the mouth of the dragon”: that is the politics. “Out of the mouth of the beast”: that is the finance, the mark without which no man may buy or sell. “Out of the mouth of the false prophet”: the false prophet is Christianity, their religion and religious systems. All of it comes out of the mouth: communication, which falls into propaganda, persuasion and lies.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world”: it is not just domestic, it is global. And they go forth “to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.” This is how the nations are being gathered to fight against Christ.

The new colonialism takes the media: old colonialism took land, new colonialism takes communication, the minds of the people. With the whole earth thinking they are Jesus Christ and the people of God, they can go into any land and extract its resources. A handful of billionaires shape information itself and decide what you see, how you see it, and what you never get to see at all. When Elon Musk bought Twitter he bought a global information battlefield. That is why the Bishop told you to read four chapters a day to the best of your ability, and to watch the classes: it is a battle for the minds of the people. And what will the Amalekite-owned networks promote? Lies, and anything that suits modern-day Israel in a good light.

precepts.why:
“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” The two horns like a lamb are the Democrats and the Republicans, the two parties, the two political systems.

He spake as a dragon: that is the mouth of the dragon in Revelation 16:13, the politics, the first of the three unclean spirits.

“And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.”

That is the finance, part of the three frogs, what comes out of the mouth of the beast. A time is coming when if you are not in cahoots, in support or allegiance with what America pushes, you will not be able to buy or sell: on a large scale that is trade, but it is also regular buying and selling. That is why they are trying to do away with the currency and bring everything into a digital system, to monitor God’s people who speak up against society.

sense.text:
The video on the billionaires and the media is summed up in this verse. “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent”: that is Esau. “Called the Devil”: a devil is a deceiver. “And Satan, which deceiveth the whole world.”

How does he deceive the whole world? Through media and social media. Things you never looked at show up in your feed because the phone heard someone mention them. Now they are buying hundreds of acres of land for AI databases that use up all the water in the area. They are investing in a future where they will not even need you on social media; the AI will think for you and push the thoughts it wants you to have, to deceive the whole world. We are being prepared for it now, so that when it comes we will not be deceived.

Some will be deceived, because they do not study. That is why the Bishop says to read four chapters a day, studying, meditating and immersing yourself in the word of God. This is what happens to those who refuse: “because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.”

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie.” Your strong delusion could be the apologist whose talking points the young lady on the podcast repeats; your strong delusion is your device, because you do not want to study. Now you are confused: Deuteronomy 28 doesn’t belong to me, maybe the white man is God, maybe the white man is the Jew. The lie is the white man’s communication, which is all lies.

“That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.” God does not save all Israel. If it were up to him, all Israel would be saved, but two thirds do not want to repent.

The Bishop often says imagery is everything, and the white man understands that communication shapes imagery. That is what Esau is doing now with his popular persuasion: in almost every meeting of Congress about UAPs, what God calls chariots, it is demonic, fallen angels, the Nephilim.

“And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee”: that is why Lucifer is called the lightbearer. The world looks at this man as the lightbearer, meaning wisdom; his wisdom shall shine no more. “And the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee”: the voice, his communication.

“For by thy sorceries were all nations deceived”: sorcery is deception, manipulation and spiritual corruption, his communication system. By his lies and propaganda all nations are deceived. That is how they will all be gathered in the Valley of Jehoshaphat, all focused on what is coming out of the skies: the black angels and the black Christ. Their minds have already been shaped that it is demonic, and their whole job is to fight against Christ. The Most High is lining them up.
“The judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters”: that great whore is America, and the waters are nations.

“With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication”: all the nations have committed fornication with America because they accept America’s policies and lies. That is why no nation on this earth stands up on its platforms and says that the so-called Negroes, Hispanics and Native Indians are the twelve tribes of Israel. The Chinese are not doing it, though they know who was enslaved in their southern provinces and on the Silk Road slave trade. Japan, India, Iran, Iraq, Turkey, the pureblooded Hamites in Africa, none of them. They say they hate America, but they are all in cahoots with her, lying in one bed fornicating.

“And the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication”: that wine is lies. They walk around drunk with it, and they love it.

It is a war of the mind, a battle for our minds. It has not become physical yet; right now it is spiritual.

“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost.” The truth of who we are has been out there for some time now, on every social media platform; even other Israelite camps bring out that we are Israel. There is no excuse.

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”: the god of this world is Satan, Esau, the so-called white man. He blinds them through his sorcery and communication.

“Lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them”: the light is the truth of the gospel, the real wisdom. He is trying to block it. That is the cherub with the flaming sword blocking the way into the garden, into the kingdom, not physically but with lies, deceit, religion and politics.

This battle is spiritual; it is not physical yet. Yet means him coming against us and putting us to death for this truth, not us picking up arms. You pick up a knife, he comes back with a gun; you get a bazooka, he comes back with a drone; you get a drone, he comes back with a satellite. Our only power in this fight is keeping the commandments of God as Israelites. We do not promote taking up arms against this system.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers”: we just saw some of those powers in the video on the media, the rich billionaire families that control the communication systems. “Against the rulers of the darkness of this world”: the same people.

“Against spiritual wickedness in high places”: think tanks and popular persuasions going out 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. There is no rest in his communication; you can turn on the TV and there is always something on.

The mind is a battlefield. “That ye present your bodies a living sacrifice”: we have to do that now, sacrificing the lust that feeds our flesh, and for some of us it means actually being put to death. Take up your cross for Christ as he did for us. It is “your reasonable service” because he did it for us; now we have to do it for him.

“And be not conformed to this world”: the war of the mind. Do not let somebody change your mind. “But be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind”: what renews our mind is God’s laws.

“That ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.” God’s laws are perfect, and his laws are his will. We are imperfect, trying to be perfect, and we can only obtain that through keeping God’s laws and the faith and blood of his Son. It is a war for our minds.

Norman Bergrun, the astrophysicist who wrote The Ring Makers of Saturn, told of the chariots making rings around Saturn by their propulsion. Asked whether beings like us piloted these vehicles, he grew uncomfortable and said there is an image of black people getting off, very tall, nine feet being an understatement. The interviewer turned it into dark skin. No: he said black. You have to stress black, because Esau will turn dark skin into a movie about Middle Eastern people, an Amalekite with dirt thrown on his face. A second witness, a NASA employee monitoring a shuttle mission from the Kennedy Space Center, said he saw an eight to nine foot tall being interacting with two astronauts. Out of the mouth of two or three witnesses everything is established. NASA destroyed his reputation for it, though he backed the same thing.

The Bible bears it out, because the angels are black. “As for the likeness of the living creatures”: these living creatures are the angels. “Their appearance was like burning coals of fire.” Coal is black. The angels are black.

precepts.why:
“And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf’s foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.”

Burnished brass is how Christ is described in Revelation: black. So the living creatures, the angels, are black, just as the man who saw them getting off the chariot said. Now Esau’s AI is rewriting what he said, calling them black or dark body vehicles and tall shadow beings, rocking everybody back to sleep. It is not alleged; he said it in an interview. The devil is a liar.

sense.text:
All of this, the history, the photos, the articles, is being revealed in the last days for a reason. It was hidden from us as a people; we thought it was sci-fi and looked at it for entertainment, but it is the things that shall come to pass. Esau had our book before we were able to comprehend it.

“Behold, the days come, when the most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth”: that is us, the twelve tribes of Israel that repent and endure until the end through all this media propaganda and persuasion, who do not deny our Lord and Savior when the heat is turned up.

“And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.” To the carnal man all of this is crazy: UFOs are the angels, and they are black. He is coming back to the astonishment of those who do not believe. These things are brought out in these last days to let us know we are getting close to the end.

They now say the chariots are fallen angels or demons, mixing Jude with Isaiah 14. Genesis gives the understanding. Seth was appointed “another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew”: Seth replaced Abel and became the chosen line.
“Then began men to call upon the name of the Lord”, because this was the lineage, the line of the sons of God.

precepts.why: “Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.” Adam was called the son of God, and in his lineage were also the sons of God: through Seth, because Abel was put to death, and not through Cain.

sense.text: “In the likeness of God made he him.” Adam “begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.” Adam was called the son of God, so his son, made in his image, was a son of God as well.
Adam “begat sons and daughters”, and so did Seth, but the record follows Seth and then Enos, because Seth was the chosen line. It is abbreviated for a reason: it is going into the sons of God.
“And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.” God took him up in a chariot; he did not die as mortals die.
“And Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.” Remember who this lineage is: the sons of God.

“The sons of God”: the lineage just read in Genesis 5. They “saw the daughters of men that they were fair”: the daughters of the nations, the other people that were created. These sons of God are not literal angels; the previous chapter gives the understanding.
“My spirit shall not always strive with man”: with men.

“There were giants in the earth in those days”, because the sons of God, who had that ultimate DNA since they were made in the image of God, began to have relations with the women of the other nations, which was forbidden. God does not like that. “The same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown”: Jude says the same thing: certain men who were before of old, ordained to this condemnation.

We are the sons of God. Brothers, you are walking gods, and we don’t give a damn who gets upset about it.

“And God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth”: that is why the Most High brought in the destruction. Later we had to pay for it; he told Abraham his children would be afflicted in a land not theirs four hundred years, because of what we did as the sons of God.

precepts.why:
“Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God”: this is the New Testament talking. That is what God calls us.

“Therefore the world knoweth us not”: they call us Negroes; to them these blacks and Hispanics killing each other could never be the people of the book, never the sons of God. “Because it knew him not”: to this day they refuse to say Christ was a black man. They have Cesare Borgia in every church, comic book and medium, while the Bible says he is black, of the tribe of Judah.
“I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.” We are gods, children of the Most High: the sons of God of Genesis 6.
“Ye are the children of the Lord your God.” This is after the Exodus: we are the children of the Lord our God because we are the sons of God.

Did something change in the prophets? No. “In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people”, in America, the diaspora, Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Europe, “there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” God calls us the sons of the living God. That is who we are.

“For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him.” The sons of the Titans are those giants, the men of renown of Genesis 6.

That is where Esau gets his movies of the fall of the Titans, his Hercules and Greek mythology and half demigods, always mixing lies with the truth, because they look at us as gods. Because of our DNA, our physical prowess, our melanin, we are the sons of God. Everybody wants our rhythm but not our blues. We are demigods on earth; that is why we dominate in every physical attribute and sport.

“There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war”: those were the offspring of the sons of God, and they were expert in war as well.

“Those did not the Lord choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge unto them”: God did not choose them; they were wicked as hell. “But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.” God wiped them out with the flood. And those spirits came right back. There is no new thing under the sun: the same spirits destroyed in the flood came back by way of the three sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, three black sons.

sense.text: “That ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints”: that is what we are doing now, earnestly contending for the faith by casting down Esau’s lies.

“Certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”: “of old”, the same words read in Genesis 6:4, the mighty men which were of old. “Turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness”: we see that today in many camps. In Jude’s time it was the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, who did not believe in marriage but in lust, fornication and orgies.

“How that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.” Jude is putting us in remembrance of the history of the wilderness, where the Israelites rebelled and were put to death, which Paul also wrote of in 1 Corinthians 10.

“And the angels which kept not their first estate”: this is talking about the sons of God. We were with God from the beginning. This is where Esau gets his Nephilim and his fallen angel crap and says those are the UFOs. Their understanding of the Bible is supremely flawed; they have no business touching our constitution. If they want to understand the scriptures, they need to come to us.

“He hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” That lineage of the sons of God that went in unto the daughters of men came right back after the flood, and they are still here today. We know because they are reserved unto the judgment of the great day, and that great day has not come yet. So it is not talking about literal angels.

“Even as Sodom and Gomorrha”: in Sodom and Gomorrha there was fornication, and “going after strange flesh”: other nations, animals, bestiality, as is done today. “Suffering the vengeance of eternal fire”: that is the lake of fire of Revelation 14.
“These filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.”

precepts.why:
“Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud”: this tells you who the people in Corinth were. They were not white people, Europeans or natural Greeks; they were Israelites. Our fathers: Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, not Abraham, Isaac and Esau.

“Under the cloud”: the chariot. “And all passed through the sea” because the chariot, the so-called UFO, was following us. “And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea”: Moses taught the law and taught us Christ, the gospel. “For they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” Christ was always present.

“But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness”, for murmuring, gossiping and fornication. “Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” That is the history Jude puts us in remembrance of: the Lord saved the people out of Egypt and afterward destroyed them that believed not.

“And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light.” Loving darkness is sin: hating God’s laws, hating this truth, hating the Bible. There are people ordained of old to stay that way, like those in 2 Thessalonians whom God gave up to strong delusion that they should believe a lie and not come into the light. Some people are bound in that darkness, the everlasting chains under darkness of Jude 6, and there is nothing you can do for them, “because their deeds were evil.”

“Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee, To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light”: to open our eyes and turn us from darkness to light, from sin to righteousness.

“And from the power of Satan unto God”: from the prince of the power of the air, his evil communication, the unclean spirits out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet. “That they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.” That is the way out of the chains of darkness Jude speaks of.

“But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies”: this is still going into the fallen ones, what Esau calls Nephilim, because they are back today, and into the evil among our people. “And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you.”

“For if God spared not the angels that sinned”: this is not literal angels in the heavens who sinned against God. They cannot sin against God; they do his will. This is the offspring of the sons of God. “And delivered them into chains of darkness”: that is sin. “To be reserved unto judgment”: the great day Jude spoke of. The same things they did back then they will continue today; they are not going to change.

“And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly”: he destroyed the old world with water and saved Noah and his whole family. “And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes”, making them an ensample. That is what Jude is talking about, not Uriel uppercutting an angel out of heaven. That is garbage malarkey. Black folk live by the saying there is nothing new under the sun, which comes from the Bible, but will not apply the same logic to the Bible and instead believe in fallen angels sleeping with women.

sense.text: Esau mixes Jude with Isaiah 14 to make his fallen angels, so keep Isaiah 14 in context. It is talking about the end and the kingdom to come. “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel”: God will have mercy on the so-called Negroes, Hispanics and Native Indians, and will only choose Israel. “And set them in their own land”: the land of Israel, reaching up through Lebanon and Syria; the whole earth will be ours, but that will be the headquarters. “And the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob”: the other nations will be joined with us and forced to learn and keep the laws of God.

“The house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were”: we were their slaves; now they will be our slaves. “And they shall rule over their oppressors.” In this verse the oppressors are called strangers, servants and handmaids, and captives.
“The Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”: that is the eternal rest, a thousand years with Christ.

“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: now the oppressor is called the king of Babylon. “How hath the oppressor ceased!”: ceased means stopped. “The golden city ceased!”: that golden city is America, Babylon the great, that great city.

“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked”: now the oppressor is called the wicked. “He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger”: it is speaking of a nation.

“How art thou fallen from heaven”: heaven is rulership, dominion. “O Lucifer, son of the morning”: Lucifer is the lightbearer, the man of all wisdom. Who is this Lucifer? In context he is the king of Babylon of verse 4, the oppressor, the captive and handmaid of verse 2, the one who smote the people in wrath in verse 6. He is the so-called white man, America, the lightbearer of all the kingdoms, whom everybody thinks wisdom flows from because of his communication, the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet. Everybody looks at this man as God and all-knowing.

“Which didst weaken the nations”: by dropping bombs on them, and with his lies and his fornication.

“I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: that is his space travel. “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: North America. “I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: his planes. “I will be like the most High.”

“Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.” “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble”: here is the point. Not is this the fallen angel, not is this the Nephilim, but is this the man. The man who made the earth tremble by dropping atom bombs everywhere: the oppressor, the great city, the king of Babylon of this chapter. It is not speaking of angels, because all the angels take their directive from the Most High God.

precepts.why:
“How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel.” Heaven is dominion, rulership, the high standing. The beauty of Israel was cast down from heaven to earth: set to a low state.

So when Isaiah says “How art thou fallen from heaven”, it is the fall of a ruling nation from its dominion, not an angel thrown out of the sky.

“And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High.” Heaven means rulership. Lucifer’s fall from heaven is his fall from rulership, and that rulership will be given to the saints.

sense.text: Job was “perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil”, “the greatest of all the men of the east.”

His sons “feasted in their houses, every one his day”: birthdays. Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts.” Sinned by keeping birthdays. Birthdays are against God; the only birthdays in the scriptures were kept by the heathen.

“Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord”: the angels are also called the sons of God, because God created them. “And Satan came also among them.” But wasn’t he kicked out of heaven as one of the fallen ones? No.
“Whence comest thou?” Satan comes before the Lord because he works for God. God created good angels and bad angels. “From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

“Hast thou considered my servant Job”: Satan’s job is to tempt us, and he is only allowed to do what God allows. He works for the Most High God. He was told he could destroy everything, but not to touch Job’s life.

precepts.why:
“I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.” The angels on the right hand are for righteousness; the ones on the left go forth for evil.

“Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead?” A spirit came forth: “I will persuade him.” “I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.”

God gave that spirit the authority, the same way he gave Satan the authority in Job 1 to tempt Job. There is no fallen angel working against God. Edomite pastors repeat that garbage rhetoric, and black pastors repeat it after them, defiling the minds of the people.

sense.text: “Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.” They do his commandments. So they were not kicked out of heaven for disobedience and trying to overthrow him; they hearken to the voice of the Most High, as we read of the spirit in 1 Kings 22 and of Satan in Job 1.
“Ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.” Keep that word minister in mind: they minister unto the Most High, and they minister unto us as well.

precepts.why: “Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?” The heirs of salvation are us, if we keep the commandments. The angels work on our behalf.

“There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes”: those are the angels on the left hand of God. “In the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them”: they minister unto God and unto us. “Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance.”

Here is the point: “They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.” They do what God tells them to do. They do not have free will to say, let’s go down and sleep with some human women today. That is not what goes on in the heavens.

“The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.” These are the good angels, and they minister unto us, delivering us from all evil, as it says in the Lord’s prayer.

sense.text: Our forefathers never looked at the angels as something demonic come to persecute and kill them, and they never ran from them. That is what Esau says, and Esau is the devil; stop listening to him. “Three men stood by him”: these are angels. “He ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself toward the ground.”

“Pass not away, I pray thee, from thy servant”: he did not run from them like a demonic spirit. “Let a little water, I pray you, be fetched, and wash your feet”, “And I will fetch a morsel of bread.” In verse 7 Abraham prepared a calf for them. He did not say, some demons, I have to get out of here.

precepts.why:
“And there came two angels to Sodom at even”, and Lot “rose up to meet them; and he bowed himself with his face toward the ground.” He did not run from them as demons; he bowed.

“Turn in, I pray you, into your servant’s house, and tarry all night, and wash your feet.” “And he made them a feast, and did bake unleavened bread, and they did eat.” They ate, because they have mouths just like us, and they were going to lie down, because they look like us. Esau calls them humanoids, but he knows those are our brothers.

“And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See thou do it not: I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren.” The angels are our brothers, not demons, but to Esau they will be demons, and El Shaddai will be that to them in that day.

The angels have tribes too. Do not be surprised if the angels at the gates in Revelation 21 are of the tribe of their gate. “Of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus: worship God.”

“I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.” The angel says the same thing: “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” The angels are our brethren.

This is Raphael speaking to Tobit, presenting himself another way: “I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of thy brethren.” And Tobit answers, “Thou art welcome, brother”, and “I have enquired to know thy tribe and thy family; for thou art my brother, of an honest and good stock.” Tobit goes on: “they were not seduced with the error of our brethren: my brother, thou art of a good stock.” The angel is called brother and is numbered among the tribes of Israel, of a good stock.

“I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.” They present the prayers of the saints because they minister unto us: ministering spirits working on our behalf, because they are our brothers.

They are not demonic spirits sent to oppose the people of the United Snakes of America. That is untrue. That is popular persuasion. That is lies.

sense.text: The popular persuasions are set in place to gather the people to fight against Christ: they call what is coming out of the heavens demons and fallen angels, and Esau knows it is Christ and his army. “In righteousness he doth judge and make war”: God is a man of war.
“His eyes were as a flame of fire”: that is Christ. “And on his head were many crowns”: he will take everyone’s crowns and put them on his head. There will be one crown; he will be the King.
“He was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood”: there is going to be a lot of bloodshed, a lot of killing. “And his name is called The Word of God.”

“And the armies which were in heaven followed him”: the same armies of Ecclesiasticus 43, the host above on the dark side of the moon. Esau knows it; that is why he made Transformers: Dark of the Moon. It is our people that are fast asleep. What do armies do? Invade and conquer.

“Clothed in fine linen, white and clean”: that is the immortal body.

“And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword”: that is the laws of God, “that with it he should smite the nations.” “And he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God”: this is what they are afraid of.
“KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

“And I saw an angel standing in the sun” (perhaps Uriel, whose name speaks of the fire of the Lord, though no precept says so). “Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God; That ye may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains”: this is what Esau is afraid of. He is going to be food.

“And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.” Here it is: the armies gathered together to fight him that comes out of the clouds. That is what the popular persuasion is laying the groundwork for.

“And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast”: through his communication, his lies. “And them that worshipped his image”: the image of Cesare. “These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.”

precepts.why: “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen”: that is talking about Babylon. “I will take vengeance”: Christ says he will take vengeance. “And I will not meet thee as a man.” Christ is coming back in that immortal body. You will not be able to nail him back to the cross as you did in Jerusalem. That is what the armies clothed in fine linen, white and clean, make reference to.

“Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him”: that is us, the Israelites. “And made no account of his labours”: Esau and the nations made no account of our labours here.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation”: that is the chariots, when they see us being beamed up. It will be strange and foreign to them. They will no longer talk of Egypt, but of the deliverance from the land of the north: a black God, a black Christ coming to redeem his black people. That will be the new talk of the town.

“This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach”: Christ will put it in their minds: these are the people you afflicted, raped, robbed, murdered and enslaved; these are my people. “We fools accounted his life madness”, “How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints! Therefore have we erred from the way of truth.”

Revelation says the armies were gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse; Ezra saw the same. “That man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven”: that is Christ. “And whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice”: he speaks the laws, and the people disintegrate, because they are guilty of that law.

“There was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea.” They will have one consent: the Most High will harden them as he did Pharaoh, and the popular persuasion is already laying the groundwork: let’s all come together and fight the demons coming from space.

“All they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.” They will be scared to death, but the Most High will harden their hearts to fight. As in Romans 9, he built up Babylon the great, this white man, this Edomite, just to destroy him.

“He neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire”, and it “burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke.” Ashes to ashes, dust to dust.

sense.text: “And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: that is NATO, the EU and America.
“These have one mind”: one consent, because of popular persuasion. “And shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: unto America.

“These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them”: Christ is going to stomp their heads in, “for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings.” “And they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.” Brothers, you are called and chosen. You are the sons of God.
